quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing for the Kazakhstan Shymkent CCPP (combined-cycle) construction contract with PGU Turkestan LLP (contract date 03-14-2023; consortium Doosan 75%, Bazis 25%): under an amended contract between the client and the consortium, the consortium's total contract amount was increased to KZT 591,428,571,360 (ex-VAT), versus KZT 535,275,300,940 (VAT 12% included) stated before; the split of the increase among consortium members is still under negotiation, so the amount attributable to Doosan is not yet fixed and will be disclosed in a further correction (the KRW contract-amount line, previously KRW 1,152,180,085,272 for Doosan's share, is now blank). The delivery end date, previously undetermined, is now 12-23-2026 (delivery start 03-14-2023); payment is billed as construction progresses.
